english: Behavior
World settings shared with everyone on this save when Gears is on the server.
Enabled
When Enabled is on, AutoReadMod automatically reads loot for everyone on this world.
Skip Already Read
When Skip Already Read is enabled, magazines at max skill and already-known books or schematics are left in the container instead of being consumed.
Read When Taken
When enabled, leave books and magazines visible in open loot. Auto-read only when they enter your inventory (taking loot, ground pickups, quest or trader rewards, and bundles).
Books
When Books is enabled, AutoReadMod automatically reads books from open loot.
Magazines
When Magazines is enabled, AutoReadMod automatically reads magazines from open loot.
Schematics
When Schematics is enabled, AutoReadMod automatically reads schematics and recipes from open loot.
Client
Settings that apply only on this computer and are not synced to other players.
Debug
Logging options for this client only.
Debug Mode
When Debug Mode is enabled, AutoReadMod writes extra detail to the game log on this client.
Audio
Sound options for this client only.
Play Read Sounds
When enabled, AutoRead plays the normal vanilla read sound for each book, magazine, or schematic it consumes.
Play Book Set Complete Sound
When enabled, AutoRead plays the special book-set completion sound when the set bonus perk unlocks.
Visualization
On-screen auto-read notification options for this client only.
Show Notifications
When Show Notifications is enabled, AutoReadMod shows on-screen notices when items are auto-read.
Show Read Effects
When enabled, AutoRead shows a tooltip with the unlocked book effect or newly craftable item after an auto-read. Already-known items are skipped. Magazines keep vanilla skill popups.
Max Visible Notifications
How many auto-read notifications can appear on screen at once. Older notices drop off as new ones appear.
Book Color
Text color for book auto-read notifications on this client.
Magazine Color
Text color for magazine auto-read notifications on this client.
Recipe Color
Text color for recipe auto-read notifications on this client.
Schematic Color
Text color for schematic auto-read notifications on this client.
